cohort: Premature neonates (<37 weeks' gestation) admitted to St. Paul's Hospital Millennium Medical College's (SPHMMC) NICU in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, between February 2022 and May 2023 were included, excluding those with congenital anomalies.
finding: Among premature neonates, respiratory distress syndrome, sepsis, and pulmonary hemorrhage were the top three causes of death, with pulmonary hemorrhage surprisingly contributing to 25% of mortalities.
mod_finding: Neonates who died from pulmonary hemorrhage had a higher rate of cesarean section delivery compared to survivors (71.9% vs 53.1%, p = 0.02).
